description: Search the insc.one Supreme Court index by natural-language issue, keyword, or legal proposition. Ranks the curated landmark corpus, then broadens with the complete Supreme Court cross-citation index (1950–2026) (the court's own verbatim headnotes). Returns ranked cases with INSC citations, one-line holdings, treatment signals, and a coverage note stating which layers contributed. No match is a real miss — it points to the official record, never an invented case.

query.description: Natural-language legal question or keywords, e.g. 'FIR mandatory registration', 'anticipatory bail charge sheet', 'CoC commercial wisdom IBC'.

year.description: Optional 4-digit year to restrict S3-index results (1950–2026).

name: search_cases
